scope: Connected related-Bandido OUT6 serializer-direction net and native byte/hold regression; exact Sheriff revision remains unqualified.

connected_net: Write-data net WDO5 feeds 2D LS174 D5 pin14.
2D Q5 pin15 routes left/up to 2L LS04 input13.
2L output12 is NOR and feeds two buffer-inverter inputs11 and9.
2L outputs10 and8 are RV copies; the 1L/1K serializer uses that reverse net.

latch_pins.clock9: active-low OUT6 strobe; LS174 captures at the positive edge

rejected_reading: The NOR input is a distinct rising wire from 2D Q15, not a connection to the nearby P9 ground bus.
rtl_interface: n8080_video_path now receives latched Q5 and derives the two complementary direction nets; bench-only independent direction signals removed.
limitations: Related-board connectivity is not proof of the exact Sheriff PCB revision.
CPU-to-WDO polarity, physical OUT6 latch edge relative to the CPU bus and PCL/reset phase remain integration requirements.
PROM/RGB capture clock, full visible/IRQ origin and DRAM/READY integration remain open.
Isolated path remains outside files.qip and production n8080_board; field2760 is not waived.
